role: R&D Project Manager / Postdoctoral Research Associate
summary: Provided scientific and operational direction for work on lipid membranes, molecular simulation and machine learning, while leading the development of MLLPA.

projectType.label: Project type
projectType.value: Research on lipid membranes and their phase transitions

paragraphs: At the University of Strasbourg, I independently directed work on lipid membranes, their phase transitions and their molecular simulation.
The research combined simulations performed with GROMACS, machine-learning approaches and the development of a three-dimensional CNN using TensorFlow.

The analysis methods produced during this work were transformed into MLLPA, a documented and reusable Python module. I developed approximately 95% of its code and created its entire website and documentation.

directContributions.label: Research
directContributions.text: Planned the methods, milestones and scientific direction with a high degree of autonomy.

directContributions.label: Simulation
directContributions.text: Performed GROMACS simulations of lipid membranes and phase transitions.

directContributions.label: Machine learning
directContributions.text: Developed machine-learning approaches followed by a three-dimensional CNN using TensorFlow.

directContributions.label: Software development
directContributions.text: Developed approximately 95% of the MLLPA code.

directContributions.label: Documentation
directContributions.text: Created the entire MLLPA website and documentation.

directContributions.label: Collaboration
directContributions.text: Occasionally continued related work with collaborators.

finalState.title: State at the end of the project
finalState.text: The analysis methods had been transformed into a reusable Python module, approximately 95% of the MLLPA code had been developed, and the website and documentation had been created, with several first-author scientific publications; work related to the 3D CNN continues occasionally.
